description: Layered tracking + analytics features (design C.16 steps 11-14): history + calendar + streaks; analytics modules + weekly/monthly reports with Recharts over summary docs; body tracking + progress photos; recovery + fatigue insight + manual deload + hydration; goals + achievements; and backup/export/import + delete account with the Zod-validated schema-version policy. Each sub-area reads/writes through existing services and leaves the build green. Depends on FEAT-004 (summaries written on completion) and FEAT-003 (history/PR data).
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT FIRST. History + calendar + streaks (app/(protected)/history): paginated completed-session list (status==COMPLETED order by completedAt desc, limit+startAfter) with filters; monthly WorkoutCalendar coloured Completed/Partial/Planned/Rest; streak logic where rest days do NOT break the streak. src/components/history/{WorkoutHistory,WorkoutCalendar}.tsx; extend workoutService with paginated queries. Unit-test streak + calendar classification.

Analytics + reports (app/(protected)/progress): pure transforms src/lib/analytics/{volume,strength,consistency,muscleVolume,personalRecords,trends}.ts over the summary docs + bounded raw reads; range filters 7D/30D/90D/6M/1Y/ALL; weekly/monthly reports read the small analyticsWeekly/analyticsMonthly summary docs (NOT full history); charts src/components/charts/{ProgressChart,VolumeChart,StrengthChart,MuscleVolumeChart}.tsx lazy-loaded via next/dynamic ssr:false with skeletons. analyticsStore; extend analyticsService. Unit-test each transform with fixed inputs.

Body tracking + progress photos (app/(protected)/body): BodyMeasurement CRUD (weight, body-fat %, measurements) + trend charts; ProgressPhoto with CLIENT-SIDE thumbnail generation (offscreen canvas downscale to an image/* Blob) + upload to Storage users/{uid}/progressPhotos/...; gallery. Must not crash without Storage creds (service short-circuits). src/components/body/{BodyWeightChart,BodyMeasurements,ProgressPhotoGallery}.tsx; bodyStore; extend bodyService. Unit-test thumbnail-blob generation yields image/* type.

Recovery + hydration (app/(protected)/recovery): RecoveryLog upsert at recoveryLogs/{yyyy-MM-dd} (idempotent) with sleep/energy/stress/soreness/motivation + computed recoveryScore 0-100 (higher=better); fatigue framed strictly as a TRAINING insight, not medical advice; manual deload feeding progression. Hydration: configurable target, +250/500/750 ml quick adds, stored when enabled. src/components/recovery/{RecoveryCard,HydrationTracker}.tsx; recoveryStore; extend recoveryService. Unit-test recoveryScore + hydration increments.

Goals + achievements (app/(protected)/goals): strength/bodyweight/custom goals with progress bars (GoalProgress, goalStore, goalService); the 8 achievements (First Workout; 10/50/100 Workouts; 10/30-Day Streak; First PR; 10 PRs; 100,000 kg Volume) stored at achievements/{key} (idempotent unlock) with an unlock animation (AchievementCard). Unit-test unlock thresholds + idempotent key-keyed unlock.

Backup/export/import + delete account (settings): src/lib/backup.ts + BackupManager. Export gathers all collections to versioned forgefit-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json. Import: Zod-validate BEFORE any write; ALWAYS take a local safety backup first; reject schemaVersion>APP_SCHEMA_VERSION (friendly msg, no writes); migrate <APP_SCHEMA_VERSION via a documented migrations map then re-validate (or reject if no path); proceed on equal via batched upserts; never overwrite completed sessions. Delete account: client deletes reachable docs + Storage objects + Auth user (reauth flow); optional documented Cloud Function functions/deleteUserData (no admin creds in client). Unit-test the AC-14 matrix.
Run verification, fix failures, set FEAT status completed, record findings, commit locally (no push).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build exit 0 with empty env, including with no Storage creds (no crash on the body/photos path).
Vitest covers: streak logic (rest day preserves streak); each analytics transform; recoveryScore 0-100; achievement unlock thresholds + idempotent unlock.

Vitest covers AC-14: export filename shape; import round-trip after a clear-cache; malformed file rejected by Zod before writing; newer-version backup rejected with no writes; older-version migrate-then-import; a safety backup is taken before any import attempt.
Reports read the summary docs, not full history (summary-doc code path present); heavy charts are next/dynamic ssr:false.
verification: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build  (exit 0, empty env)

pnpm vitest run src/lib/analytics src/lib/backup src/components/history src/components/recovery src/components/goals src/components/body  (transforms, streak, recoveryScore, achievements, AC-14 import/export matrix, thumbnail blob)
Live Storage photo upload and live summary reads with real/emulated creds are recorded as 'needs verification during implementation'.
findings:
FEAT-005 complete. All four gates green with EMPTY .env.local: pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit), pnpm build (next build; 20 routes incl. /history /progress /body /recovery /goals, next-pwa SW generated, nothing throws at import/build), and 176 Vitest tests pass + 2 version-gated skips (62 new; prior 116 still green). No Firebase was mocked to fake success; every new service short-circuits to firebase/not-configured under empty env, including the body/photos path with no Storage creds.

PURE LIBS (highest-value, unit-tested). src/lib/analytics/consistency.ts: dayKey/dayOfWeekId/isRestDay + computeStreak (REST DAYS DO NOT BREAK THE STREAK — walk-back skips plan isRest days; a non-rest empty day breaks; today-empty tolerated) + classifyCalendarDay (Completed/Partial/Planned/Rest; Partial = completedSets<totalSets or IN_PROGRESS/ABANDONED with progress) + buildMonthCalendar. src/lib/analytics/range.ts: AnalyticsRange 7D/30D/90D/6M/1Y/ALL + rangeStart/withinRange. src/lib/analytics/{volume,strength,muscleVolume,trends}.ts: PURE transforms over the SUMMARY docs (weeklyVolumeSeries/aggregateMuscleVolume read WeeklySummary; e1rmSeries reads bounded exerciseHistory ring; bodyWeightSeries/bodyFatSeries over measurements; weeklyReport/monthlyReport collapse the summary docs). src/lib/recovery.ts: computeRecoveryScore (weighted 0-100, higher=better: sleep .30/energy .25/soreness .20/stress .15/motivation .10, soreness+stress inverted, sleep vs 8h, falls back to energy when sleep absent) + recoveryBand/recoveryInsight (framed strictly as TRAINING insight, not medical) + addHydration/hydrationProgress/HYDRATION_QUICK_ADDS_ML [250,500,750] + buildRecoveryLog. src/lib/achievements.ts: isUnlocked/newlyUnlockedKeys/buildAchievementUnlocks (idempotent, id=key). src/lib/goals.ts: direction-aware goalProgress/isGoalAchieved. src/lib/thumbnail.ts: fitWithin (pure sizing) + isImageBlob/blobToImageType + generateThumbnailBlob (offscreen-canvas downscale to image/jpeg Blob, browser-only). src/lib/backup.ts: backupEnvelopeSchema (Zod) + backupFileName (forgefit-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json) + buildEnvelope + migrations map + validateAndPlanImport/parseImportJson implementing the C.11 schema-version policy (reject newer; migrate <APP_SCHEMA_VERSION via sequenced map then RE-VALIDATE, else reject; proceed on equal) + BACKUP_MESSAGES.

SERVICES (ServiceResult, client-null guarded; converters added for ProgressPhoto/GoalRecord/Achievement/WorkoutNote via present()-spread). workoutService: listCompletedSessionsPage (status==COMPLETED, completedAt desc, limit+startAfter cursor pagination; returns {sessions,cursor,hasMore}) + listSessionsInRange (calendar) + listWorkoutPlans. bodyService: listBodyMeasurements/upsertBodyMeasurement/deleteBodyMeasurement (single-doc idempotent) + listProgressPhotos + uploadProgressPhoto (generates client-side thumbnail, uploads full+thumb to users/{uid}/progressPhotos/{,thumbs/}, writes metadata doc; guards on BOTH db and storage non-null so the no-Storage-creds path short-circuits — never crashes; rejects non-image blobs) + getPhotoUrl. recoveryService: getRecoveryLog/upsertRecoveryLog (date-keyed recoveryLogs/{yyyy-MM-dd} idempotent)/listRecoveryLogs. goalService: goal CRUD + listAchievements/unlockAchievement/evaluateAndUnlock (key-keyed idempotent unlock). analyticsService: added listWeeklySummaries/listMonthlySummaries/listExerciseHistories (summary-doc report reads, NOT full history). backupService: exportBackup (gathers all 14 collections, serialises Timestamp->ISO) + serializeBackup + importBackup + importBackupWithSafety (ALWAYS takes a local safety export FIRST, then validates+writes; batched merge upserts, NEVER overwrites a COMPLETED session) + deleteUserData (deletes reachable Firestore docs + recursive Storage objects; Auth-user deletion left to authService/the optional Cloud Function; no admin creds in client).

STORES (NOT persisted; hydrated from services/Firestore): analyticsStore (range + weekly/monthly/histories caches), bodyStore (measurements+photos), recoveryStore (today+recent+manualDeload), goalStore (goals+achievements, dedup by key). FIRESTORE REFS added for all new collections; firestore.indexes.json gained a progressPhotos(date desc) entry.

UI (RSC shells + client islands). Routes app/(protected)/{history,progress,body,recovery,goals} + BackupManager wired into /settings. history/{WorkoutHistory (paginated list + day filter + streak pill),WorkoutCalendar (monthly coloured grid, Monday-first)}. charts/{ProgressChart,VolumeChart,StrengthChart,MuscleVolumeChart} are next/dynamic ssr:false over ChartViews.tsx (recharts) with ChartSkeleton fallbacks — recharts never enters the shared chunk (progress route 2.27kB, body 3.83kB First Load delta). progress/ProgressDashboard reads the summary docs + runs the pure transforms + renders the lazy charts + weekly/monthly report cards. body/{BodyWeightChart,BodyMeasurements,ProgressPhotoGallery}. recovery/{RecoveryCard (sliders + live recoveryScore + manual-deload toggle),HydrationTracker}. goals/{GoalProgress (RHF+Zod CRUD + progress bars),GoalsAndAchievements (derives metrics from sessions/PRs, evaluates+unlocks, renders the 9-achievement grid)}; achievements/AchievementCard (framer-motion pop). ui/empty-state.tsx added.

TESTS (62 new). src/lib/analytics/consistency.test.ts (streak incl. REST-DAY-PRESERVES-STREAK, non-rest break, today-empty tolerance, calendar classification), transforms.test.ts (every volume/strength/muscleVolume/trends/range transform with fixed inputs), src/components/recovery/recovery.test.ts (recoveryScore bounded 0-100, monotonic, hydration increments/clamp/progress), src/components/goals/achievements.test.ts (unlock thresholds + idempotent already-unlocked + key-keyed id + goal progress direction-aware), src/components/body/thumbnail.test.ts (fitWithin sizing + image/* blob contract), src/lib/backup.test.ts (AC-14 matrix: filename shape, round-trip after clear-cache, malformed Zod reject before write, newer-version reject no writes, older-version migrate-then-import [version-gated .runIf; machinery exercised version-independently], safety-backup-first).

FOLLOW-UP / NEEDS VERIFICATION DURING IMPLEMENTATION (no real/emulated creds; do NOT claim done without them): (1) live Storage photo upload + thumbnail write against the C.9 storage.rules contentType/size split, and getDownloadURL reads. (2) live summary-doc reads (listWeekly/MonthlySummaries) + the paginated history composite index (status,completedAt) + startAfter cursor behavior. (3) backupService import batched-upsert against live rules incl. the never-overwrite-COMPLETED-session guard, the ISO<->Timestamp re-hydration round-trip, and recursive Storage delete in deleteUserData. (4) GoalsAndAchievements metric derivation uses listRecentSessions (COMPLETED only, bounded) — totalVolumeKg/prCount are approximations from the loaded page; for exact lifetime tallies wire the monthly-summary aggregate once summaries are populated against creds. (5) RecoveryCard manual-deload flag lives in recoveryStore (transient); FEAT-003 follow-up (2) to feed recoveryScore + e1rmTrend into ProgressionRecommendation can now consume recoveryStore + analytics/strength.isE1rmTrendFlat. (6) achievements remain 9 keys per FR-32 (design prose says 8) — unchanged from FEAT-002 finding; reconcile the type/design, not the data, if a strict 8 is required.
